available.quote: The board shall certify as qualified for a license by endorsement as an architect or registration as a registered interior designer an applicant who: (a) Qualifies to take the prescribed licensure or registration examination, and has passed the prescribed licensure or registration examination or a substantially equivalent examination in another jurisdiction

requirements.value: Applicant must qualify to take the prescribed examination and have passed it or a substantially equivalent examination in another jurisdiction and satisfied the internship requirements; or hold a valid license from another U.S. jurisdiction with substantially equivalent criteria; or have passed the prescribed examination and hold a valid NCARB certificate with a valid license from another state. Out-of-state architects seeking endorsement must also complete a 2-hour board-approved class on wind mitigation techniques.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of s. 455.227(1), s. 481.221, or s. 481.223, or any rule of the board or department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of s. 455.227(1), s. 481.221, or s. 481.223, or any rule of the board or department lawfully adopted pursuant to this part or chapter 455.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain or procure a license to practice architecture by bribery or fraudulent misrepresentations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to obtain or procure a license to practice architecture by bribery or fraudulent misrepresentations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice architecture revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country for an act that would constitute a violation here.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice architecture revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country, for any act that would constitute a violation of this part or of chapter 455.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of a crime directly relating to the practice of architecture or the ability to practice architecture.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of architecture or the ability to practice architecture.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report or record known to be false, or willfully failing to file a required report.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report or record that the licensee knows to be false, willfully failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, willfully impeding or obstructing such filing, or inducing another person to impede or obstruct such filing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising goods or services in a fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading manner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising goods or services in a manner that is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act of fraud, deceit, negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of architecture, including failure to ensure responsible supervising control.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act of fraud or deceit, or of negligence, incompetency, or misconduct, in the practice of architecture, including, but not limited to, allowing the preparation of any architectural studies, plans, or other instruments of service in an office that does not have a full-time Florida-registered architect assigned to such office or failing to ensure the responsible supervising control of services or projects, as required by board rule.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing on a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing on a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice architecture.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice architecture contrary to this part or to a rule of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a registered architect.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a registered architect.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to influence or overrule the professional judgment of an architect in a manner that would constitute negligence or threaten public health, safety, or welfare.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to influence or overrule the professional judgment of an architect by an act that, if carried out, would constitute negligence contrary to the exercise of professional judgment in accordance with professionally accepted standards of practice or would threaten the public health, safety, or welfare.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing building code inspection services without satisfying the required insurance requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing building code inspection services under s. 553.791, without satisfying the insurance requirements of that section.

insurance_required.quote: Performing building code inspection services under s. 553.791, without satisfying the insurance requirements of that section.

definition_quote.value: the rendering or offering to render services in connection with the design and construction of a structure or group of structures which have as their principal purpose human habitation or use, and the utilization of space within and surrounding such structures. These services include planning, providing preliminary study designs, drawings and specifications, job-site inspection, and administration of construction contracts.

interior_designer_certification_availabl.quote: A person seeking to obtain a certificate of registration as a registered interior designer and a seal pursuant to s. 481.221 must provide the department with his or her name and address and written proof that he or she has successfully passed the qualification examination prescribed by the Council for Interior Design Qualification

interior_design_services_defined.quote: "Interior design" means designs, consultations, studies, drawings, specifications, and administration of design construction contracts relating to nonstructural interior elements of a building or structure.

design_build_authorized.quote: a general contractor who is certified or registered pursuant to the provisions of chapter 489 is not required to be licensed as an architect when negotiating or performing services under a design-build contract as long as the architectural services offered or rendered in connection with the contract are offered and rendered by an architect licensed in accordance with this chapter.

firm_licensed_architect_ownership_minimu.quote: one or more of the principal officers of the corporation or limited liability company, or one or more partners of the partnership, and all personnel of the corporation, limited liability company, or partnership who act in its behalf in this state as architects, are registered as provided by this part.

seal_required.quote: Each registered architect shall obtain one seal in a form approved by rule of the board and may, in addition, register her or his seal electronically in accordance with ss. 668.001-668.006. All final construction documents and instruments of service which include drawings, plans, specifications, or reports prepared or issued by the registered architect and being filed for public record shall bear the signature and seal of the registered architect who prepared or approved the document and the date on which they were sealed.

seal_surrender_required_on_license_termi.quote: When the certificate of registration of a registered architect or interior designer has been revoked or suspended by the board, the registered architect or interior designer shall surrender her or his seal to the secretary of the board within a period of 30 days after the revocation or suspension has become effective.
